Use this data visualization style guide to create a uniform look and feel to all of Tax Policy Center's charts and graphs. This site contains guidelines that are in line with data visualization best practices and proven design principles. It also eliminates the burden of design and color decisions when creating charts.

These guidelines are primarily for publishing charts to the website. Minor sizing and typographic adjustments need to be made to insert charts into documents.

Use the navigation bar above to find what you need:

- **[Branding](branding.qmd)**: Required font setup, typography guidelines (typefaces, sizes, and cases for chart elements), and TPC's color palette and selection principles (categorical and sequential color schemes for one through seven or more groups).
- **[Publications](publications.qmd)**: Word templates for briefs, fact sheets, research reports, and business documents, plus Excel graphing resources, the PowerPoint template, and mapping resources.
- **[Data Viz](data-viz.qmd)**:
   - Guidance on graphing and mapping tools (Datawrapper, Excel, R)
   - Examples of common chart types with style tips and templates
   - Guidance on TPC tables
